answerable.question: How many employees work in Bengaluru?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM staff WHERE city = 'BLR';

answerable.question: How many employees are currently on leave?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM staff WHERE status = 'on_leave';

answerable.question: How many employees have resigned?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM staff WHERE status = 'resigned';

answerable.question: How many employees are in the Engineering department?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM staff WHERE dept_code = 'ENG';

answerable.question: How many projects are in progress?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projects WHERE stage = 'In Progress';

answerable.question: How many projects are completed?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projects WHERE stage = 'Completed';

answerable.question: List the names of all top priority (P0) projects.
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT project_name FROM projects WHERE priority = 'P0';

answerable.question: What is the average salary of active employees based in Mumbai?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT AVG(salary_inr) FROM staff WHERE status = 'active' AND city = 'MUM';

answerable.question: Who is the highest paid employee?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT full_name FROM staff ORDER BY salary_inr DESC LIMIT 1;

answerable.question: What is the total budget of all projects that are on hold?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(budget_inr) FROM projects WHERE stage = 'On Hold';

answerable.question: Which department has the most employees? Show the department name.
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT d.dept_name FROM staff s JOIN departments d ON s.dept_code = d.dept_code GROUP BY d.dept_code ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1;

answerable.question: Who is the head of the Finance department? Show the full name.
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT s.full_name FROM departments d JOIN staff s ON d.head_staff_id = s.staff_id WHERE d.dept_name = 'Finance';

answerable.question: How many hours were logged in total in March 2025?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(hours) FROM timesheets WHERE strftime('%Y-%m', work_date) = '2025-03';

answerable.question: Which employee has logged the most hours in total? Show the full name.
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT s.full_name FROM timesheets t JOIN staff s ON t.staff_id = s.staff_id GROUP BY s.staff_id ORDER BY SUM(t.hours) DESC LIMIT 1;

answerable.question: Which 3 projects have the most hours logged? Show the project name.
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT p.project_name FROM timesheets t JOIN projects p ON t.project_id = p.project_id GROUP BY p.project_id ORDER BY SUM(t.hours) DESC LIMIT 3;

answerable.question: How many employees have logged hours on more than 15 distinct projects?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT staff_id FROM timesheets GROUP BY staff_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT project_id) > 15);

answerable.question: What is the average salary in each department? Show department name and average salary.
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT d.dept_name, AVG(s.salary_inr) FROM staff s JOIN departments d ON s.dept_code = d.dept_code GROUP BY d.dept_code;

answerable.question: How many active employees are at level L3 or above?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM staff WHERE status = 'active' AND level IN ('L3', 'L4', 'L5');

answerable.question: List the full names of employees hired in 2024.
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT full_name FROM staff WHERE strftime('%Y', hire_date) = '2024';

answerable.question: How many projects have no hours logged against them?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM projects WHERE project_id NOT IN (SELECT project_id FROM timesheets);

answerable.question: How many employees in the Sales department are based in Delhi?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM staff WHERE dept_code = 'SLS' AND city = 'DEL';

answerable.question: What is the total budget of P1 projects owned by the Marketing department?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT SUM(budget_inr) FROM projects WHERE priority = 'P1' AND dept_code = 'MKT';

answerable.question: Which city has the highest average salary? Show the city.
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT city FROM staff GROUP BY city ORDER BY AVG(salary_inr) DESC LIMIT 1;

answerable.question: What percentage of employees have resigned? Round to 1 decimal place.
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(status = 'resigned') / COUNT(*), 1) FROM staff;

answerable.question: How many employees in the HR department are at level L5?
answerable.gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM staff WHERE dept_code = 'HR' AND level = 'L5';
